capabilities: Insert the current time into a bullet by pressing Space twice
Cycle between short and long timestamp formats with extra spaces
Inherit the previous sibling's timestamp format on Enter and outdent
Remove the timestamp when indenting, keeping the text
Customize time format, prefix and suffix in settings
disambiguation: Not a task or checkbox manager; it only inserts, cycles and removes timestamps on list items.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. Installable through BRAT as a beta plugin; migrating from the withdrawn 0.0.1 means copying data.json into the new plugin folder and reassigning hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to stamp list items with the current time or keep one timestamp format across sibling bullets.

relations.evidence: Outdent (Shift+Tab or Outliner’s Enter on an empty child)

summary: Inserts and cycles short or long timestamps on list bullets, carrying the previous sibling's format.
